premises.text: Rapid satellite growth makes spectrum noisier and threatens consistent Earth–space communications
premises.evidence_span: it's becoming much noisier. It's the spectrum noise and the consistency of communication that MagnaStar is addressing

premises.text: Current spectrum obtainment, coordination, and rights-protection processes use outdated ~25-year-old technology
premises.evidence_span: using technology that's 25 years old for the legacy space industry rather than infrastructure for the modern space sector

premises.text: 247X simulates when multiple satellites will be co-linear and potentially interfere in Earth–space signal paths
premises.evidence_span: We simulate how multiple satellites, when they will be in a co-linear event and potentially interfere with one another from their signal communications in between Earth and space

premises.text: Simulation is embedded in coordination infrastructure that automates operator workflows to expedite coordination and protect spectrum rights
premises.evidence_span: We embed that simulation technology into coordination infrastructure in order to expedite the process of how satellite operators work together

premises.text: The platform monitors ITU filings and near-real-time interference risk for operators and regulators in one software application
premises.evidence_span: monitoring in near real-time to ensure consistent communications between Earth and space

premises.text: Operators can run multiple uplink, downlink, or inter-satellite interference simulations for real-time passes or long-term coordination agreements
premises.evidence_span: I can go ahead and run multiple simulations at a time, which is currently non-existent within the existing technology

premises.text: A future spectrum exchange depends on validated non-interference while subleasing spectrum under coordination agreements
premises.evidence_span: This spectrum exchange can only come to fruition as we have validated that it will not cause interference as we're subleasing spectrum and the coordination agreements are still being adhered to

value.text: Clear, consistent Earth–space communications through eased spectrum simulation and coordination
value.evidence_span: bring relief to the space sector

secondary_value.text: Establish clear pathways of communications among operators and with regulators
secondary_value.evidence_span: we establish clear pathways of communications for existing satellite operators between Earth and space

causal_links.evidence_span: We embed that simulation technology into coordination infrastructure
This spectrum exchange can only come to fruition as we have validated that it will not cause interference
without clear communications, the entire space sector becomes in jeopardy
easing the complexities of space spectrum
building this to be a spectrum exchange

notes: LOIs, pre-purchases, and military contract excluded as traction. Demo UI features folded into platform premises (§4.1(5)). Spectrum exchange kept as separately revisable future module with explicit prerequisite dependency on validated non-interference. ITU delegate credential not coded as causal premise.
